svg.title: A smooth sphere approaches a three-sphere chain
svg.desc: Numerical weighted quotient flow at t=0, 3 and 12, with a separate infinite-time limit. Circle-fiber size diagrams show two necks narrowing. They are not Euclidean embeddings of the four-dimensional geometry.

g.text: Numerical quotient flow · circle-fiber size diagram · four-dimensional ambient space
One smooth sphere; both necks positive

Circle radius = φ⁻¹ᐟ². Colors mark the three intervals between centers.
The 3D diagram does not depict the transverse intersection angles in the actual 4D space.
